relatedEntities.name: Amoxicillin capsules / suspensions
relatedEntities.notes: Formulation and sterile steps are separate DP recipes

properties.appearance: White to off-white crystalline powder (often trihydrate)

hazardStatements: May cause allergy or asthma symptoms — confirm SDS
hazards.notes: β-lactam sensitizer — dedicated equipment and containment policies common.

overview: Amoxicillin is typically produced by enzymatic (or chemical) acylation of 6-APA with a D-p-hydroxyphenylglycine side chain. 6-APA itself is obtained from penicillin fermentation and enzymatic cleavage. The process spans fermentation, enzymatic transformation, and careful isolation of a sensitizing β-lactam.
manufacturingSummary: Upstream penicillin fermentation → 6-APA → enzymatic synthesis of amoxicillin → crystallization (often trihydrate) → drying. Cross-contamination control for β-lactams is a plant-wide design driver.

environmentBaseline.containment: β-lactam dedicated suites / pressure cascades common

ehsHighlights: β-lactam allergy sensitization — occupational exposure limits and suite design

routes.name: Enzymatic acylation of 6-APA (industrial preferred)
routes.summary: Condense 6-APA with side-chain donor using penicillin acylase-class biocatalysts; crystallize amoxicillin hydrate.
advantages: High selectivity vs older chemical routes

steps.title: Enzymatic synthesis
steps.description: Charge 6-APA and side-chain donor with biocatalyst under controlled pH and temperature. Monitor conversion and hydrolysis side reactions.
steps.mechanismNotes: Penicillin acylase catalyzes acylation of the 6-amino group; competing hydrolysis is managed by conditions and donor choice.

apparatus.notes: Enzyme reactor / packed bed if immobilized

steps.title: Isolation / crystallization / drying
steps.description: Crystallize amoxicillin (often trihydrate), wash, and dry under controlled humidity and temperature to form specification.
steps.scaleNotes: Form control and β-lactam dust containment dominate finishing.

scaleUp.labToKilo: Enzyme loading and mass transfer for immobilized systems

sourceRefs.note: Educational biocatalytic outline — confirm patents and site packages

routes.name: Upstream: penicillin fermentation → 6-APA
routes.summary: Ferment penicillin, isolate, enzymatically cleave side chain to 6-APA for coupling.

steps.title: Fermentation
steps.description: Produce penicillin in aerated fermenters; harvest broth.

steps.title: Cleavage to 6-APA
steps.description: Enzymatic deacylation of penicillin to 6-APA; isolate intermediate.

disclaimer: Educational β-lactam process scaffold. Not a GMP procedure. β-lactam plants require specialized containment and regulatory controls beyond this document.
